samir patel: Hey team, quick one 0I think my calendar has swapped the orientation time. The invite says 09:00 PT, my calendar shows 18:00 CET. Are we actually at 18:00 CET?
noah: Orientation is at 9:00am Pacific. 9:00 PT == 17:00 UTC. 18:00 CET could be because your calendar is set to CET and the client converted incorrectly. What calendar client are you using?
samir patel: Using Outlook desktop on a company Mac. Also, I imported the .ics from the invite because I like having a local copy.
devex: Importing the .ics can cause issues if the TZ definitions aren't standard. Quick check: open the .ics in a text editor and look for lines like

BEGIN:VTIMEZONE
TZID:Europe/Paris
...
END:VTIMEZONE

If TZID is a named zone (Europe/Paris) it's usually ok. If its a fixed offset like TZ:+0100 then Outlook might re-interpret.
samir patel: ah ok will check. Also, will the Zoom link in the invite be the same if I join from the calendar vs the Zoom client? I had an old company where different invites had different passcodes.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: Live orientation has a single canonical Zoom link embedded in the primary calendar invite. The recording will be uploaded to the onboarding drive within 3 hours. Access: new-hires group + HR + hiring manager. Public links are not allowed.
lia (hr): If anyones timezones make live attendance hard, we do a brief follow-up drop-in for APAC next week and post the recording. If you want the recording to be retained longer than 90 days, DM me with the file path and reason.
noah: Also note: when Outlook shows a different time, try toggling Settings -> General -> Time zone, then restart the app. VPNs and system prefs can cause double conversions.
samir patel: I opened the .ics and I see TZID:America/Los_Angeles and also a line with DTSTART:20260304T090000Z. Should DTSTART be Z? That Z makes it UTC I thought.
devex: Good catch. DTSTART ending with Z indicates an absolute UTC time. If the .ics mixes TZID and a Z suffix thats a mismatch. That can cause clients to display incorrect local times. If youd like, paste the first 30 lines (remove any private links) and Ill eyeball it.
samir patel: pasted in DM to @devex.
lia (hr): For join guidance: use the Zoom link in the calendar invite and rely on the event start time displayed on the company's published schedule (https://redwood.company/onboarding/schedule). We standardize on PT for live orientation.
samir patel: Thanks all. One last thing  will managers get a shareable recording link, or do I need to request access?
onboarding-bot: Recording policy: recordings default to restricted access. Managers auto-added if they're in the hiring metadata. Otherwise, file owners (HR) can add additional viewers on request.
noah: If you need an external-safe link, ask HR to create a sanitized shareable export.
samir patel: Awesome. Ill join 9am PT and check the recording after. Appreciate the rapid help. :thumbsup:
